edits.new: The guardrail check codes the agent returns are the fallback reasons, because no source set lists them (ASM-0552). The agent platform of DL33 is rwb-agent (P10), and its task queue `rwb-agent` is the only place a model call is made; no other service and no workflow code calls the model endpoint. The two read-only tools of rwb-agent are case facts and score through the data-product contract of rwb-source-data (P1), and extracted document fields through the REST contract of rwb-document (P5). The fallback-rate measure of RWB-TE-013 (below 10 percent per month) belongs to rwb-reporting under Architecture v5 slide 41; this story asserts only the agent version and the fallback fact on each entry, and the measure definition, its target and its window are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1316) until approved as rwb-reporting rows at the measures review of wave 1. The deployment values, the rwb-agent login name and its secret, the alert thresholds, the runbook text and the route path are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2189); they are carried as chart values with one reviewed copy per environment, and the login is referenced through a platform secret.
